full_prompt_en: A square color photograph is an extreme close view of a person in rose-tinted round sunglasses, turned toward the right against a nearly black background. The face fills the image, with the forehead and back of the hair cut by the upper and left edges. Warm auburn hair catches streaks of copper light as it curves away from the temple. The glasses have a pale translucent frame and a large circular lens, whose reddish surface reflects several small bright points. The far lens is mostly cut off by the right edge. A thin temple arm runs across the cheek, casting a narrow horizontal shadow below the eye. The nose projects toward the right and becomes the brightest sharply defined facial ridge. Below it, the lips are closed and lightly highlighted, with a natural textured surface rather than a glossy finish. The cheek and jaw show warm yellow-gold light interrupted by deeper red-brown shadows. In the lower left, a cluster of tiny turquoise, blue, white, and amber lights glitters against a dark piece of clothing or accessory. A few soft red circles float in the lower right background, out of focus and detached from any clearly visible object. The close framing leaves no room to identify a place; the image is organized by face, glass, and colored light. Noticeable photographic grain and slight softness in the shadows give the photograph a tactile, analog feel. Directional warm light enters from the upper right and brushes the hair, frame of the glasses, nose, and lips, while the left side slips into black. The colored points at the bottom provide small cool counterweights to the dominant amber and red. No lettering is visible. The overall composition is intimate and electric, balancing a calm right-facing profile with strong warm glow, dark negative space, and scattered jewel-like light.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形彩色照片：镜头极近地拍摄一个戴玫瑰色圆镜片眼镜、朝右转头的人，背后几乎全黑。面孔填满画面，额头和后侧头发被上缘与左缘截断。暖赤褐发在太阳穴附近弯转时接住铜色光纹。眼镜有浅色半透明镜框和一片大圆镜片，微红的镜面反射几个小亮点。另一片镜片大部分被右边缘裁掉。一根细镜腿横过脸颊，在眼睛下方投出窄横影。鼻子向右伸出，成为脸上最明亮、最清楚的凸脊。其下嘴唇闭合并有轻微高光，表面自然有纹理，而非光滑发亮。面颊与下颌的暖黄金沙光被更深红褐阴影打断。左下方，一簇青绿、蓝、白和琥珀色小光点在深色衣物或配饰前闪烁。右下背景还有几个柔软红圆点失焦漂浮，无法对应到清楚可见的物件。紧贴画框没有留下辨认地点的空间；图像由面孔、镜片和色光组织。可见的摄影颗粒与阴影里轻微柔化赋予照片可触的胶片感。定向暖光从右上进入，掠过头发、镜框、鼻梁和嘴唇，左侧则滑入黑暗。底部彩色光点作为少量冷色平衡，抵住占主导的琥珀与红色。画中没有文字。整体构图亲密而带电，把平静的朝右侧脸与强烈暖光、深色负空间及散落宝石般亮点结合。
style_prompt_en: Color photography uses close cropping, deep shadow, and warm directional glow to isolate a small set of tactile surfaces. Amber and red-brown dominate the broad areas, while scattered turquoise, blue, and white pinpoints add brief cool contrast. Glassy highlights, translucent edges, soft bokeh, and fine grain coexist within a dark field. The brightest ridges stay clear, but peripheral forms dissolve quickly into shadow and shallow focus. Small reflected circles repeat without becoming a regular pattern, creating a restless sparkle around an otherwise stable focal plane. The overall look is intimate, saturated, and slightly analog, with jewel-like color embedded in near-black space.
style_prompt_zh: 彩色摄影以紧贴裁切、深沉阴影和暖色定向光孤立少数可触表面。琥珀与红褐色占据宽阔区域，散落的青绿、蓝与白色小亮点提供短暂冷色对比。玻璃状高光、半透明边缘、柔散景和细颗粒共存于深色场里。最亮的凸脊保持清楚，外围形体则迅速消失在阴影与浅景深中。小反光圆点无规则地重复，在稳定的焦平面周围形成不安定闪光。整体外观亲密、饱和且略具胶片感，宝石般色彩嵌在近黑空间中。
theme_en: A warm close profile behind rose-tinted round glasses
theme_zh: 戴玫瑰色圆镜片眼镜的暖光近距离侧脸
name: Mick Rock
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
